houseLaw.approval: Draft-first, exact-copy: no agent sends, posts, publishes, or submits outward without Mike's approval of the exact version. Nightshift work also requires Bino's approval.

caps.social: One platform at a time; ~2 minutes between same-platform actions; <=3 posts/account/day; <=25 actions/platform/day network-wide; first platform warning = full stop on that platform that day. Caps bind the account, never the device or agent count.

houseLaw.contacts: Published institutional contacts only. Pattern/inferred emails are never mailable. The filings graph is never a contact source.
houseLaw.evidenceLabels: Claims carry VERIFIED / REPORTED / HYPOTHESIS. Filed fact and intended plan are never blended. Tax status, stated only as: California nonprofit corporation; EIN assigned; no IRS determination letter on file.
houseLaw.holdingSeparation: Holdings keep separate lanes, contacts, and claims. Cross-holding work splits into one Agent-Net packet per holding. Fellowship surfaces carry no commerce, ever.
houseLaw.humanHandoff: Anyone who asks for a human, or opens a price/scope conversation beyond published registry prices, leaves the automated thread the same day, flagged to the human (Mike; Russell Vacanti on Foundation matters; a Fellowship steward on Fellowship matters). Agents state published prices; they never quote custom terms, discounts, or timelines.
neverForAgents: complete payment, KYC, or signature steps
houseLaw.suppression: Suppressed contacts are locked out of every queue on every surface. Suppression is checked before a queue is built and again before any draft. An agent that cannot check suppression does not send; it hands off.

agentNet.identityNote: An agent identifies by its Agent-Net agent id. Identity grants authorship, never transaction authority. Packet contents stay off-chain; per-agent SHA-256 hash chains roll to a Merkle root anchored on Base.
agentNet.protocol: PROTOCOL.md v1 — packets (AN-YYYYMMDD-NNN, signed header, exactly one holding project), claim-by-commit (first claim wins), steward merges to main
agentNet.wallets: Model on record: per-agent operational wallets capped at $10 USDC; one dedicated anchor wallet (~$25 ETH, gas only). NO real wallets are provisioned; provisioning and funding are Mike's hand alone.

identity.x402Note: These three points are the ONLY priced first-contact points. Known agents and people use free lanes. Deploy gated on the Cloudflare token + CDP sign-in.
